 Production Engineer Job description 
Are you an analytical problem-solver with a strong eye for manufacturability and process optimization? Would you like to play a key role in translating engineering designs into efficient and stable production and assembly processes? Then this Production Engineer position at BKL could be the perfect next step for you. 
As a Production Engineer, you are the link between engineering and production. You ensure that designs are translated into a manufacturable product structure and an efficient assembly process. In this role, you play an important part in New Product Introduction (NPI), optimizing existing production processes, and safeguarding quality and manufacturability. 
Your responsibilities - Set up and maintain the Manufacturing BOM and product structures in the ERP system. - Translate engineering data into efficient manufacturing and assembly steps. - Support NPI projects and guide prototype and serial production. - Optimize and safeguard production and assembly processes. - Prepare assembly instructions, control plans, and tools. - Review and implement product and process changes. - Act as a troubleshooter in case of technical disruptions. - Work closely with Engineering, Purchasing, Planning, Sales, and Supply Chain. 
What do you bring? - A completed Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, or a related field. - At least 5 years of relevant experience in production engineering, process engineering, or work preparation. - Experience with ERP and PLM systems. - Knowledge of production processes, materials, and manufacturability. - Strong analytical skills and a proactive mindset. - Good command of Dutch and English.

Keep a high-tech factory moving In a high-tech manufacturing environment, having the right material available at the right moment is essential. A missing component, delayed delivery or unreliable supplier can directly impact production. As an Operational Buyer, you will take responsibility for the operational purchasing process and the availability of materials and components. Suppliers and commercial agreements are already in place; your focus is on making sure purchase orders are executed correctly, deliveries arrive as promised and potential supply issues are addressed before they impact the factory. This is a hands-on role where you will be in direct contact with suppliers and work closely with planning, manufacturing and logistics. You will monitor the supply situation, manage changing priorities and take ownership when deliveries or material availability are at risk. Your work will include: Managing and following up on purchase orders for technical materials and components. Monitoring delivery performance and acting when suppliers are at risk of missing agreed lead times. Maintaining direct contact with suppliers regarding order status, delays and delivery commitments. Coordinating material availability with planning and manufacturing teams. Taking ownership of shortages, supply disruptions and other operational issues until they are resolved. Escalating critical supply issues and coordinating actions with the right internal and external stakeholders. Making operational purchasing decisions based on lead times, delivery requirements and costs. Identifying recurring supply issues and contributing to structural improvements. Maintaining accurate purchasing and material data in SAP or another ERP system.
